narrative.details:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
narrative.objectives: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.
narrative.offerRewardText: Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique.Well, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
